limitations: First cut only: no provider wiring, body complement/background wrapper, search, scatter/reduction, moving-body updates or full solver step.
Optional first value moment/XSPH, wall-viscosity radial weight, cover and tensile/shifting bundles remain unimplemented in this new family; old paths remain intact.
Raw native-fp32 routes fail broad actual-input tests for both C2 and C4; they remain explicit diagnostics and their fast rates are not presented as accepted results.
Protected float32 uses paired arithmetic and split static geometry prepared on host fp64 from actual fp32 vertex coordinates; this is not an ordinary single-word-fp32 analytic precision result.

Kernel-only seven-sample warm and graph CUDA-event medians at 1048576 pairs, 256-thread blocks, reused buffers; no serialized multi-round final performance claim. Clocks/power/desktop activity uncontrolled.
Geometry preparation/upload and buffer sizes are separately recorded; complete preparation/launch/readback and peak driver-memory costs are not measured for this first cut.
2D integer-power recurrence replaces repeated general pow calls. 3D timing/native bodies are byte-identical across the 2D-only refactor, as checked above.
Default fp32 changed deterministically to the protected implementation after the diagnostics failed; explicit diagnostic/protected native bodies are byte-identical to the measured versions.
Register caps are exposed for subsequent experiments but not tuned or selected as new defaults here.
